title: Innokin PZP Max Replacement Coils
description: The Innokin PZP Max Replacement Coils are designed to deliver exceptional flavour and vapour production for users of the Innokin CoolFire PZPulse Pod Kit. Featuring advanced mesh technology and organic cotton wicking, these coils ensure even heating and consistent performance with every puff. Available in three resistance options, the PZP Max Coils cater to a variety of vaping styles. The 0.2ohm coil supports a powerful output of 60-80W for dense vapour and bold flavour, while the 0.4ohm coil provides a balanced experience at 40-60W. For those who prefer cooler and smoother draws, the 0.6ohm coil operates at 20-24W, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Quick and easy to install, the PZP Max Coils feature a plug-and-play system for hassle-free replacements. Whether you’re chasing clouds or craving intense flavour, these coils are the perfect choice to get the very best performance from your Innokin CoolFirePZPulse kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
